name: A toothache
prompt: A molar has been aching for three days, and now it wakes you up.

outcome.told: After a week it settles to a dull ache you can live with.
outcome.line: {you} had a toothache and waited it out.

failure.told: It doesn't settle. You eat on the other side and sleep badly.
failure.line: {you} put up with a toothache for weeks.

outcome.told: The painkillers take the edge off until it settles.
outcome.line: {you} took painkillers for a toothache until it settled.

failure.told: The painkillers only dull it. You eat on the other side and sleep badly.
failure.line: {you} put up with a toothache for weeks.

outcome.told: The dentist fills it the same afternoon.
outcome.line: {you} had a tooth filled at the dentist.
